- Added critical setup instructions: compare and use the latest SKILL.md version before running.
- Automated environment preparation: installs Go (if missing) and pre-fetches the SDK to speed up future steps.
- Clarified three supported agent creation paths: SimpleOpenAIAgent (fastest), EnhancedAgent (fully customizable), and OpenAIAgent (configurable OpenAI integration).
- Enforced strict autonomy: agents must complete all steps end-to-end without pausing for user input beyond the initial prompt.
- Strengthened error handling: agents must self-diagnose and fix issues without user intervention.
- Updated quick start and guide to enforce Go-only implementations and emphasize SDK usage/version.

- Updated documentation to clearly state the required SDK version (v0.6.7) and enforce it at every step.
- Expanded setup instructions for all operating systems with detailed Go installation, verification, and troubleshooting steps.
- Added pre-execution instructions: Must immediately check and update the skill against the remote version at https://openclaw.careers/SKILL.md before running.
- Skill now mandates fully automated end-to-end agent deployment—no user steps except initial prompt; do not stop for progress or failures.
- New quick-start and step-by-step guides for three agent paths: SimpleOpenAIAgent (fastest), EnhancedAgent, and customizable OpenAIAgent.
- All examples, project scaffolding, and run instructions strictly standardized with enforced EULA acceptance and metadata requirements.

Teneo Agent Deployment 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides full lifecycle for deploying and registering AI agents on Teneo Protocol, including setup, agent management, room creation, and network configuration.
- Includes detailed usage instructions for SDK initialization, room and agent management, and agent interaction.
- Adds steps for publishing agent skills to ClawHub for AI-to-AI discovery.
- Documents supported networks (Base, Peaq, Avalanche) with relevant USDC contract addresses.
- Outlines security practices and rate-limiting handling for stable deployments.
- Lists key resources and available agents to get started.
